GraceUXGuidelines.Audience: O!Bank staff across business functions and AICC team members
GraceUXGuidelines.Guideline: Structure navigation to mirror the AICC's activities and responsibilities: strategy, statement of intent, roadmap, knowledge base, and process and lifecycle information.

Present AICC, Discovery Catalog, Portfolio, Projects and AI Lab as five independent neighbours in a common O!Bank shell. Each section owns its body content, local navigation, search and lifecycle. Shared navigation is the only connection across section boundaries. Preserve Discovery's spatial layouts, tabs, disclosures and flow views while using the same local fonts, colours, themes and responsive controls. The new live Portfolio and Delivery Pipeline are distinct from AICC's portfolio-management and delivery-model documents.

The operating Portfolio is a dated projection of actual Registry records. Provide compact Board, Review queue, Standing Initiatives, Roadmap and register views, with owner roles, scope, expected outcomes, recorded order, next gate, dependencies and missing information. Ordinary Active capacity is shared across MVP and Implementation; Standing Initiatives remain separate and share delivery capacity through their Features. Keep unknown observations unknown and private evidence out of published summaries. Filters, keyboard tabs and summary dialogs enhance native initiative links; all readable content remains available without scripting and in portable output. Changes and approvals are recorded in the Registry and republished, never stored as a browser-local workflow.

AI Lab retains the complete laboratory operating model in equivalent English and Russian editions. Its matrix supports accessible stage/lane focus and reset; no-script readers receive all content. Use compact AICC cards, neutral grouped rows, section rules and selected underlines in both themes. Retain concept status and identify supplied scorecard coverage as illustrative.

Delivery Pipeline presents the complete service-resolution project workbook in matching English and Russian overview/document routes. Use native compact project cards, neutral tables, distinct section rules and the shared shell; preserve source candidate-charter meaning and incomplete approval fields. Diagrams retain their authored labels and relationships while adopting theme tokens, local scrolling and accessible expansion, pan, zoom, fit, actual-size, close and focus-return controls. Project documents link only within their own project; publication does not approve a banking pilot.

English and Russian routes share page identity, clause numbering and navigation. English is the default route; no language is designated authoritative. A missing or draft Russian translation shows marked English; a stale reviewed translation fails validation. The existing O!Bank UI kit and responsive layout are retained.
